```{r oat_reset, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
maintain = "maintain_tes_oat"

plt_reset = results_all |>
  filter((!is.na(.data[[maintain]])), .data[[maintain]] > 0, oa_t >= design_oat) |>
  ggplot(aes(oa_t, .data[[maintain]])) +
    geom_line(aes(color = building)) + # aes(color = desc)
    # facet_wrap(~ building) +
    theme(legend.position="top") +
    labs(title = "TES minimum charge reset limits", x="OAT (°C)", y="Minimum charge %", color="") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1), labels = percent(seq(0,1,0.1))) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,16), breaks = seq(0,16,2))

plt_reset
ggsave(glue("../figs/working/2026-1019/oat_reset.png"), plot = plt_reset, width = 14, height=8, units = "in")
```

```{r totals, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
emissions_var = "awhp_h_emissions" #elec_emissions
baseline = summary |> 
  filter(desc == "No TES") |>
  rename(elec_emissions_base = elec_emissions) |>
  rename(elec_h_emissions_base = elec_h_emissions) |>
  select(building, elec_emissions_base, elec_h_emissions_base)

plt_tot = summary |>
  left_join(baseline, by = "building") |>
  filter(desc != "No TES") |>
  mutate(elec_emissions_diff = 100*(elec_emissions - elec_emissions_base)/elec_emissions_base) |>
  mutate(elec_h_emissions_diff = 100*(elec_h_emissions - elec_h_emissions_base)/elec_h_emissions_base) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(elec_emissions_diff, elec_h_emissions_diff), names_to = "emissions_diff", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(tes_control_id, value, fill = emissions_diff)) + 
    geom_col(aes(fill = emissions_diff), color = 'black', position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = percent(value/100, accuracy = 1, style_positive = "plus")),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      vjust=1.8) +
    geom_point(data = tes_control_scenarios, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, shape = tes_legend), alpha=0, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    labs(y="Percentage difference", x = "Control strategy", title = "Electricity use emissions compared to no-TES scenario", shape="", fill="") +
    theme(legend.position="top") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = tes_control_scenarios$tes_control_id) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-60,10), breaks = seq(-60, 10, 10), labels = percent(seq(-0.6,0.1,0.1))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("elec_emissions_diff" = "orange", "elec_h_emissions_diff" = "red"), labels = c("elec_emissions_diff" = "Total", "elec_h_emissions_diff" = "Heating")) +
    facet_grid(reorder(tes_sizing, eq_scen_id) ~ building)
    # facet_nested(. ~ tes_sizing + building)
    # facet_grid(building ~ tes_sizing) # this will be better when more scenarios are added
    # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1)) #+
    # coord_flip() # to flip axes

plt_tot
# ggsave(glue("../../figs/working/2026-0809/elec_emissions.png"), plot = plt_tot, width = 14, height=8, units = "in")
```

```{r equip_sizes, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
baseline_sizes = summary |> 
  filter(desc == "No TES") |>
  rename(awhp_base = AWHP_num) |>
  select(building, awhp_base)

equip_scenarios_plot = tes_control_scenarios |>
  # filter(desc!="No TES") |>
  select(tes_legend) |>
  add_row(tes_legend = "<span style='color:red'># = unmet hours</span>")

sizes = summary |>
  left_join(baseline_sizes, by = "building") |>
  # mutate(AWHP = (awhp_hhw - awhp_base)/awhp_base,
  mutate(AWHP = 100*(AWHP_num - awhp_base)/awhp_base,
  AWHP_actual = 100*(AWHP_num_over - awhp_base)/awhp_base,
  AWHP_actual = ifelse(abs(AWHP - AWHP_actual) < 1, NA, AWHP_actual)
  # tes_diff = 100*(TES - tes_base)/tes_base # this is zero since baseline is no TES
  )
  # select(building, desc, AWHP_size, AWHP_size_over, awhp_base, AWHP, AWHP_actual)
  # pivot_longer(cols = c(awhp_hhw, TES_charge), names_to = 'equipment', values_to = 'size') |>
plt_sizes = sizes |>
  filter(desc != "No TES") |>
    # select(building, desc, equipment, size)
  ggplot() + 
    geom_col(aes(tes_control_id, AWHP, fill = "AWHP"), color = 'orange') +
    geom_col(aes(tes_control_id, AWHP_actual, fill = "AWHP_actual"), color = 'orange', alpha=0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(tes_control_id, AWHP, label = percent(AWHP/100, accuracy = 0.1, style_positive = "plus")), vjust=1.5) +
    # geom_text(data = over_max, aes(tes_control_id, plot, label = tot_over), color="red") +
    geom_point(data = equip_scenarios_plot, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, shape = tes_legend), alpha=0) +
    labs(y="Percentage difference", x="Control strategy", title = "Number of AWHPs compared to no-TES scenario", fill = "", shape="") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = tes_control_scenarios$tes_control_id) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(20,-100), breaks = seq(-100, 20, 20), labels = percent(seq(-1,0.2,0.2))) +
    scale_fill_manual(labels = c("AWHP" = "Peak day sizing #", "AWHP_actual" = "Actual operating # (if smaller reduction)"), values = c("AWHP" = "orange", "AWHP_actual" = "red")) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_markdown()) +
    facet_grid(tes_sizing ~ building)
```

``` {r TES_utilization_hours, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
plt_util_hrs = results_all |>
  filter(desc != "No TES") |>
  # filter(hhw < awhp_cap_h_total) |>
  group_by(building, eq_scen_id, tes_sizing, tes_control_id) |> # desc, eq_scen_id
  # summarize(utilized_hrs = sum(TES_load>0), unutilized_hrs = sum(TES_load==0)) |>
  summarize(utilized_hrs = sum(TES_load>0 | TES_charge==0), unutilized_hrs = sum(TES_load==0 & TES_charge!=0)) |>
  mutate(total_hrs = utilized_hrs + unutilized_hrs,
    utilization = 100*utilized_hrs/total_hrs) |>
  ggplot(aes(tes_control_id, utilization)) +
    geom_col(fill = 'orange') +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(utilization/100, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust=-0.5) +
    geom_point(data = tes_control_scenarios, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, shape = tes_legend), alpha=0) +
    labs(x="Control strategy", y="% hours", title = "Percentage of hours TES is utilized (i.e. discharging)", shape="") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = tes_control_scenarios$tes_control_id) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,100), breaks = seq(0,100,20), labels = percent(seq(0,1,0.2))) +
    theme(legend.position = "top") +
    facet_grid(reorder(tes_sizing, eq_scen_id) ~ building)
```

``` {r TES_utilization_hours_szn, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
plt_util_hrs_szn = results_all |>
  mutate(quarter = quarter(datetime)) |>

    quarter == 1 ~ "Jan-Mar",
    quarter == 2 ~ "Apr-Jun",

  )) |>

  mutate(total_hrs = utilized_hrs + unutilized_hrs,
```

```{r aggregated timeseries, hour, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
TES_var = "TES_charge"
plt_hr = function(df, scen, equip_scenarios) {
  scen_desc = equip_scenarios$desc[scen]
  plt = df |>
    filter(eq_scen_id == scen) |>
    mutate(month = month(datetime, label=T), hour = hour(datetime)) |>
    select(building, month, hour, awhp_hhw, .data[[TES_var]]) |>
    group_by(building, month, hour) |>
    summarise(AWHP = sum(awhp_hhw), TES_SOC = sum(.data[[TES_var]])) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(AWHP, TES_SOC),
      names_to = "meter",
      values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(hour, value, color = meter)) +
        geom_line() +
        facet_grid(building ~ month, scales = "free") +
        labs(title = glue("Aggregated hourly HHW load served - {scen_desc}"), y = "Heating load (W)")
    return(plt)
}
```

```{r aggregated timeseries_szn, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
TES_var = "TES_charge"
plt_szn = function(df, scen, equip_scenarios) {
  scen_desc = equip_scenarios$desc[scen]
  plt = df |>
    filter(eq_scen_id == scen) |>
    mutate(quarter = quarter(datetime), hour = hour(datetime)) |>
    mutate(season = case_when(
      quarter == 1 ~ "Jan-Mar",
      quarter == 2 ~ "Apr-Jun",
      quarter == 3 ~ "Jul-Sep",
      quarter == 4 ~ "Oct-Dec",
    )) |>
    mutate(season = fct_reorder(season, quarter)) |>
    select(building, season, hour, awhp_hhw, .data[[TES_var]]) |>
    group_by(building, season, hour) |>
    summarise(AWHP = sum(awhp_hhw), TES_SOC = sum(.data[[TES_var]])) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(AWHP, TES_SOC),
      names_to = "Meter",
      values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(hour, value, color = Meter)) +
        geom_line() +
        facet_grid(building ~ season, scales = "free") +
        labs(title = glue("Aggregated hourly HHW load served - {scen} -  {scen_desc}"), y = "Heating load (W)")
    return(plt)
}
```

```{r sample_days_awhp, include = FALSE, eval = FALSE}
  summarize(elec_emissions = sum(.data[[emissions_var]]), .by = c(building, eq_scen_id, desc, date, quarter))

plot_dates_baseline_emissions = plot_dates_emissions |>
  filter(desc == "No TES") |>
  rename(elec_emissions_base = elec_emissions) |>
  select(building, date, elec_emissions_base)

plot_dates_emissions = plot_dates_emissions |>
  filter(desc != "No TES") |>
  left_join(plot_dates_baseline_emissions, by = c("building", "date")) |>
  mutate(elec_emissions_diff = 100*(elec_emissions - elec_emissions_base)/elec_emissions_base,
  building = as.double(building)) |>
  filter(abs(elec_emissions_diff) > 1e-1) |>
  inner_join(plot_dates, by = c("building", "date")) |>
  mutate(x = force_tz(ymd_h(str_c(as.character(date), " 11 PM")), "US/Pacific"), y = Inf) |>
  mutate(season_date = str_c(season, " (", date, ")")) |>
  mutate(quarter = ifelse(season == "Peak Day", 0, quarter)) |>
  left_join(select(equip_scenarios, eq_scen_id, tes_sizing, tes_control_id), by = "eq_scen_id")

plt_days = function(df, id, dates) {

  peakdate = dates |>
    filter(building == id, season == "Peak Day") |>
    select(date) |> pull()
  
  df = df |>
    filter(building == id,
    tes_sizing %in% c("2x Partial", "3x Partial")
    ) |>
    mutate(season = ifelse(date == peakdate, "Peak Day", season),
        quarter = ifelse(date == peakdate, 0, quarter)) |>
    filter(date %in% filter(dates, building == id)$date) |>
    mutate(season_date = str_c(season, " (", date, ")")) |>
    mutate(awhp_charging = ifelse(TES_charge_delta > 0, TES_charge_delta, 0)) |>
    mutate(awhp_load = awhp_hhw - awhp_charging) #|>
    # left_join(select(summary, building, desc, AWHP_size), by = c("building", "desc"))
    # left_join(plot_dates_emissions, by = c("building", "desc", "date")) |>
  #   select(eq_scen_id, desc, quarter, season_date, datetime, date, awhp_load, TES_charge, awhp_hhw, AWHP_size)
  # print(df)

  hp_on_ctrl = df |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id) |>
    mutate(on = operate_hp_tes, group = cumsum(on != lag(on, default = FALSE))) |>
    filter(on == TRUE) |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id, season_date, quarter, group) |>
    summarize(xmin = min(datetime), xmax = max(datetime)+hours(1))

  hp_on_oat = df |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id) |>
    mutate(on = (!(operate_hp_tes) & hp_tes != 0), group = cumsum(on != lag(on, default = FALSE))) |>
    filter(on == TRUE) |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id, season_date, quarter, group) |>
    summarize(xmin = min(datetime), xmax = max(datetime)+hours(1))

  hp_on_unintentional = df |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id) |>
    mutate(on = (hp_tes == 0 & awhp_hhw > 0), group = cumsum(on != lag(on, default = FALSE))) |>
    filter(on == TRUE) |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id, season_date, quarter, group) |>
    summarize(xmin = min(datetime), xmax = max(datetime)+hours(1))

  hp_on_over_max = df |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id) |>
    mutate(on = awhp_hhw - awhp_cap_h_total > 1e-3, group = cumsum(on != lag(on, default = FALSE))) |>
    filter(on == TRUE) |>
    group_by(desc, tes_sizing, tes_control_id, season_date, quarter, group) |>
    summarize(xmin = min(datetime), xmax = max(datetime)+hours(1))

  oat_plot = df |>
    ggplot() +
      geom_line(aes(datetime, oa_t, color="OAT"), linetype = 2) +
      labs(x = "", y = "(°C)", color="", title = glue("Building {id}")) +
      scale_x_datetime(labels = NULL) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("OAT" = "black")) +
      facet_grid(. ~ reorder(season_date, quarter), scales = "free_x") +
      theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

  emissions_plot = df |>
    ggplot() +
      geom_line(aes(datetime, elec_emissions_rate, color="Emissions"), linetype = 2) +
      labs(x = "", y = "(gC02e/Wh)", color="") +
      scale_x_datetime(labels = NULL) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Emissions" = "gray")) +
      facet_grid(. ~ reorder(season_date, quarter), scales = "free_x") +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

  loads_plot = df |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(awhp_load, TES_charge, awhp_hhw), # TES_load),
        names_to = "equipment",
        values_to = "load") |>
    mutate(equipment = case_when(
      equipment == "awhp_hhw" ~ "AWHP (total)",
      equipment == "awhp_load" ~ "AWHP (load)",
      # equipment == "awhp_charging" ~ "AWHP (charging)",
      # equipment == "TES_load" ~ "TES discharge",
      equipment == "TES_charge" ~ "TES SOC"
      )) |>
    ggplot() +
      geom_rect(data = hp_on_ctrl, aes(xmin=xmin, xmax=xmax, ymin=0, ymax=Inf, fill="HP Enabled (Calc. Hrs)"), alpha=0.1) +
      geom_rect(data = hp_on_oat, aes(xmin=xmin, xmax=xmax, ymin=0, ymax=Inf, fill="HP Enabled (OAT Reset)"), alpha=0.1) +
      geom_rect(data = hp_on_unintentional, aes(xmin=xmin, xmax=xmax, ymin=0, ymax=Inf, fill="Unintended HP Operation"), alpha=0.1) +
      geom_rect(data = hp_on_over_max, aes(xmin=xmin, xmax=xmax, ymin=0, ymax=Inf, fill="HP Operation Over Max"), alpha=0.1) +
      geom_line(aes(datetime, load, color = equipment)) +
      geom_line(aes(datetime, awhp_cap_h_total, color="awhp_cap_h_total"), linetype=2) +
      geom_text(data = filter(plot_dates_emissions, building == id, tes_sizing %in% c("2x Partial", "3x Partial")),
        aes(x, y, label = str_c(percent(elec_emissions_diff/100, accuracy=0.1, style_positive = "plus"), " emissions")), vjust = 2, hjust = 1, size=3) +
      labs(x = "Hour", y = "Energy use (W)", color = "", fill = "", shape = "") +
      geom_point(data = plot_tes_control_scenarios, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, shape = tes_legend), alpha=0, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("AWHP (load)" = "pink", "TES discharge" = "orange", "TES SOC" = "orange", "AWHP (charging)" = "pink", "AWHP (total)" = "red", "awhp_cap_h_total" = "red"), labels = c("awhp_cap_h_total" = "Max AWHP capacity")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("HP Enabled (Calc. Hrs)" = "green", "HP Enabled (OAT Reset)" = "blue", "Unintended HP Operation" = "orange", "HP Operation Over Max" = "red")) +
      scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H") +
      ggh4x::facet_nested(tes_sizing + tes_control_id ~ reorder(season_date, quarter), 
      labeller = labeller(
        tes_sizing     = function(x) ifelse(x == "", "No TES", x),
        tes_control_id = function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "-", x)
      ),
      scales = "free_x") +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_blank())
    
  # tbl = select(equip_scenarios, eq_scen_id, desc) |>
  #   mutate(line = glue("{eq_scen_id}: {desc}")) |>
  #   pull(line) |>
  #   paste(collapse = "\n\n") |>
  #   str_replace_all(",", ",\n")

  final_plot = oat_plot + patchwork::plot_spacer() + emissions_plot + patchwork::plot_spacer() + loads_plot +
    patchwork::plot_layout(ncol=1, heights = c(1, -0.3, 1, -0.3, 8)) #+
    # plot_annotation(caption = tbl, theme = theme(plot.caption.position = "plot", plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = -120, l = 945))))
  # collect_legends(final_plot)
  final_plot
}

# sample_dates
plt_days(dat, "180", plot_dates)
```
